page.layout: One column of running text, printed page 4, with the running head "PRÆFATIO." above it. The page number "4" is at the top left. Below the last line, at the right, is a catchword-like mark. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: [?]tæ conditio aurem nobis vellicauit, nihil præ- ter votum piorum nos facturos, si priorem Mi- scellaneorum vicem suppleremus additione grauissimarum meditationum sacrarum, de iis inprimis Religionis capitibus, quæ hinc inde Ecclesias reformatas pluribus jam annis mi- rum quantum vexarunt: atque à venerabili Patre D. Davide Pareo, Ecclesiasticæ pacis & tranquillitatis incredibili sititore, ea judicii dexteritate examinata sunt, ut nihil exactius, nihil sanctius in hoc genere desiderari posse videatur. Quare, Christiane Lector, nihil du- bitamus, hocce officium nostrum tibi fore pergratum. Rogamus Deum Patrem Domini nostri Iesu Christi, ut deficientibus operariis alios in messem velit mittere, ac tandem par- vuli sui gregis sub cruce salutem & liberatio- nem ingemiscentis clementer misereri.
Nomen eius sit benedictum in seçula, Amen.

page.notes: The first word is partly unclear: the opening ligature reads as "ctæ" or "ætæ", so it is marked [?]. The catchword at the lower right is hard to read and is marked [?]. "Davide Pareo" is set in small capitals in the print and is rendered here as italic, which is an approximation. "seçula" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for "sæcula".
